privacy.description: At Giftisan, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the creative and personal information you share with us.
privacy.more_details_desc: We are happy to provide detailed information about our data encryption and security standards.
privacy.section1_desc: We collect information you provide directly to us: name, email address, contact phone number, shipping address, and shop/product details. We also collect usage data to improve your browsing experience.
privacy.section2_desc: Your data is used to process transactions, fulfill orders, coordinate deliveries, and communicate with you about your account. We never sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.section3_desc: We share necessary fulfillment details (like delivery address and phone number) with artisans and courier partners to ensure safe delivery. Online payments are securely processed through certified, PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways (such as Paymob), supporting credit cards and Egyptian mobile wallets. We never store full card numbers on our servers.
privacy.section4_desc: We implement robust security protocols, including encryption and secure server environments, to protect your sensitive data from unauthorized access.
privacy.section5_desc: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. You can manage your notification preferences directly in your profile settings.
privacy.section6_desc: You may permanently delete your account and associated personal data at any time directly within the application under Profile Settings > Delete Account. Alternatively, you can submit an account deletion request by emailing support@giftisan.com or contacting us through our online support form. Upon deletion, your profile, authentication credentials, addresses, and saved preferences are permanently removed.

terms.description: Effective starting April 2026. Please read these terms carefully to understand your rights and obligations while using the Giftisan platform.
terms.questions_desc: We're here to help clarify any aspect of our platform agreement.
terms.section1_desc: By accessing or using the Giftisan platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, you may not use our services.
terms.section2_desc: Giftisan is a curated marketplace connecting independent Egyptian artisans (Sellers) with clients (Buyers). Giftisan facilitates transactions, discovery, and payment escrow, while makers craft and fulfill their creations directly.
terms.section3_desc: Artisans must ensure all products are authentically handcrafted or bespoke. Because items are crafted by hand, natural variations in raw materials (such as wood grain, ceramic glaze bubbling, or textile dye tones) are celebrated hallmarks of authenticity and not manufacturing defects. Artisans are responsible for accurate descriptions, protective packaging, and fulfilling orders in a timely manner. Giftisan reserves the right to moderate listings that violate our quality standards.
terms.section4_desc: Giftisan processes transactions through certified payment gateways (including Paymob, credit cards, and mobile wallets). Customer payments are held securely and released to the artisan's withdrawable balance 7 days following confirmed delivery. For the 2026 season, Giftisan operates with 0% platform commission for all registered Founding Artisans.
terms.section5_desc: Artisans retain full ownership of their original designs and craft. By listing products, artisans grant Giftisan a non-exclusive license to feature product photography for marketing, spotlights, and promotional campaigns.

shipping.description: Giftisan connects you directly with master makers across Egypt. Each item is packed and dispatched with utmost care from the artisan's independent workshop.
shipping.more_details_desc: If you have specific questions about a shipment, custom timeline, or governorate delivery, our team is ready to assist.
shipping.section1_desc: Every order is prepared and dispatched directly by the artisan from their workshop. Once dispatched, you will receive notifications and status updates as your package makes its way to your doorstep.
shipping.section2_desc: We deliver across all Egyptian governorates (Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, Delta, Canal cities, and Upper Egypt). Delivery fees are calculated transparently during checkout based on the destination. For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, couriers require payment upon handover. If an item arrives damaged or materially incorrect, you are fully protected under our 48-hour Buyer Protection guarantee by reporting it with photos in your account.
shipping.section3_desc: Ready-to-ship items are typically handed over to couriers within 2-4 business days. For personalized or made-to-order pieces, the artisan requires dedicated crafting time as stated on the product page.
shipping.section4_desc: We require and support all artisans in using sturdy, eco-conscious packaging that ensures delicate ceramics, glass, woodwork, and jewelry arrive in pristine condition.
shipping.section5_desc: You can track the fulfillment status of your orders at any time through your Giftisan profile under the Orders tab, with live stage updates from packaging to delivery.

refund.description: At Giftisan, we celebrate authentic craftsmanship and fair commerce. Our refund policy ensures peace of mind for both buyers and creators.
refund.more_details_desc: If you have specific questions about a return or an order issue, our support and mediation team is here to assist.
refund.section1_desc: Because our marketplace features handmade and made-to-order pieces, standard change-of-mind returns are subject to artisan agreement. Personalized or customized items (with bespoke engravings, names, or custom dimensions) cannot be returned unless damaged or materially defective. Orders for custom or made-to-order pieces may only be cancelled within 24 hours of placement, before the artisan begins workshop fabrication.
refund.section2_desc: If a product arrives damaged in transit or differs materially from its listing, please contact the artisan or Giftisan support within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the damaged item and packaging.
refund.section3_desc: Upon claim review, the artisan will offer a complimentary repair, replacement, or full/partial refund. Giftisan provides active mediation to ensure a fair resolution in every case.
refund.section4_desc: If a physical return is required, return shipping is covered by the artisan or platform if the item arrived damaged or materially misrepresented.
refund.section5_desc: Approved refunds are credited back directly to the original payment method (Credit/Debit Card or Mobile Wallet via Paymob) within 5 to 10 business days following claim finalization.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Giftisan is Egypt's premiere marketplace for unique, handcrafted gifts. We connect independent Egyptian artisans with collectors who appreciate authentic, soulful craftsmanship.
faq.q2: Where do the products come from?
faq.a2: Every piece on Giftisan is handmade by local independent artisans across Egypt, from Cairo and Alexandria to Fayoum and Upper Egypt.
faq.a3: Yes, we facilitate shipping to all governorates within Egypt, ensuring your handcrafted products reach you safely.
faq.q4: How can I join as an artisan?
faq.a4: Independent Egyptian makers can apply to open their own shop through our Artisan Portal. We look for authentic, high-quality handcrafted work.

about.hero_title: Where Egyptian Heritage Meets Modern Craft
about.hero_subtitle: Giftisan is a curated sanctuary for independent Egyptian artisans, heritage workshops, and thoughtful shoppers seeking one-of-a-kind handcrafted treasures.
about.origin_subtitle: Connecting the threads of Egyptian heritage with modern homes.
about.origin_p1: Giftisan was born out of a deep respect for the master makers of Egypt. From the pottery wheels of Fayoum and the brass workshops of historic Cairo to the woven textiles of Upper Egypt and Sinai beadwork, our land possesses an unmatched legacy of handcrafted brilliance.
about.origin_p2: In a world of mass-produced, disposable goods, we believe in pieces that carry a soul, a human story, and enduring quality. When you shop on Giftisan, you aren't just buying a product—you are supporting an independent artisan's livelihood and keeping heritage craftsmanship alive for generations to come.
about.mission_subtitle: Four core promises that define everything we do at Giftisan.
about.pillar1_desc: Every order directly supports independent artisans and small family-run workshops across Egypt, ensuring fair returns for extraordinary dedication.
about.pillar2_desc: We celebrate Egypt's rich artisanal lineage—embracing traditional techniques like mother-of-pearl inlay, copper repoussé, kilim weaving, and hand-blown glass.
about.pillar3_desc: No generic factory replicas. Every creation is crafted by real hands, inspected for quality, and often customizable with bespoke touches.
about.pillar4_desc: Seamless nationwide shipping across all 27 governorates, buyer protection, and direct transparent communication between collectors and artisans.
about.cta_title: Ready to be part of our story?
about.cta_desc: Explore unique treasures crafted by local Egyptian artisans, or join our community of master makers.

artisan_terms.section1_desc: The Artisan operates as an independent seller and craftsman, not as an employee, franchisee, or joint-venture partner of Giftisan. The Artisan exercises exclusive control over workshop hours, techniques, raw materials, and creative methods, and remains solely responsible for local Egyptian tax registrations and municipal craft permits where applicable.
artisan_terms.section2_desc: Giftisan is exclusively dedicated to genuine Egyptian craftsmanship. Every listed item must be designed, handmade, finished, or customized by the artisan. Commercial mass-manufactured factory goods, dropshipped foreign imports (e.g., from generic wholesale markets), and counterfeit replicas are strictly prohibited. Listing unverified factory items constitutes immediate grounds for shop suspension without prior notice. Natural variations in handcrafted materials (wood grains, ceramic glazes, textile weaves) are celebrated hallmarks of authenticity, not defects.
artisan_terms.section3_title: 3. Studio Operations, Lead Times & Courier Handover
artisan_terms.section3_desc: Artisans must fulfill orders within their declared processing time. Ready-to-ship products must be packaged within 2 to 4 business days. For customized or made-to-order creations, the artisan must accurately specify realistic production timelines. When partner couriers arrive for collection, parcels must be securely packed with the Giftisan order code clearly marked. Repeatedly missing courier pickups damages buyer trust and may result in temporary listing deactivation.
artisan_terms.section4_desc: Handcrafted goods (ceramics, woodwork, glass, leather, and jewelry) require protective, drop-resistant packaging (corrugated cardboard, bubble wrap, corner guards). If an item arrives broken due to inadequate workshop packaging, the artisan is responsible for replacement or cost resolution. If an item is damaged despite proper packaging due to courier mishandling, Giftisan will advocate and file a carrier compensation claim on the artisan's behalf.
artisan_terms.section5_desc: Artisans set their own retail prices. Founding Artisans receive the commission rate shown in their dashboard, currently 0% for the 2026 founding programme. Each sale, fee, refund, reserve, and payout appears in an itemized balance ledger. Net earnings are released to the artisan's withdrawable balance 7 business days after confirmed delivery, subject to the stated holding, refund, and fraud-review rules. Giftisan will give advance notice of material fee or payout-rule changes; they apply only from the stated effective date.
artisan_terms.section6_desc: Personalized or bespoke items may be excluded from a change-of-mind return only where permitted by applicable law and when they match the agreed specifications. Consumer rights for defective, unsafe, or misdescribed products are never reduced. Giftisan records claim evidence and gives the artisan 48 hours to respond where practicable. An artisan is charged only for a resolution reasonably attributable to the product, description, or packaging, with the reason and amount recorded in the balance ledger and a route to request review.
artisan_terms.section7_desc: Artisans retain ownership of their original creations, designs, studio marks, and listing media. By publishing a listing, the artisan grants Giftisan a non-exclusive, royalty-free, revocable licence to host, display, translate, and promote that listing solely to operate and market the marketplace. The licence ends when the listing is removed, except for a reasonable period needed to complete outstanding orders, resolve claims, and retain legal records. Giftisan may not sell or license the artisan's work to third parties without separate written permission.
artisan_terms.section8_desc: Artisans must not redirect buyers to complete off-platform payments for marketplace sales. Either party may end the relationship after outstanding orders, refunds, and payouts are handled. Except for urgent safety, fraud, or unlawful-content risks, Giftisan will provide a reason for suspension or removal, a reasonable opportunity to cure where appropriate, and a route to appeal. Ending or suspending a shop does not remove Giftisan's obligation to account for and pay undisputed balances under the published payout rules.
